articles.title: Cochin Shipyard and SDHI Compete for $300 Million-Plus Aframax Tanker Order
articles.description: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) and South Korea’s Samsung Heavy Industries (SDHI) are competing for a major Aframax tanker construction contract valued at more than $300 million, highlighting growing international interest in India’s shipbuilding capabilities.
